81	func (m rootModel) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
82		var cmds []tea.Cmd
83	
84		switch msg := msg.(type) {
85		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
86			m.width = min(msg.Width, maxWidth)
87			m.height = msg.Height
88			m.memoriesTab.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
89			m.injectionTab.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
90			m.historyTab.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
91			m.settingsTab.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
92			if m.detailPage != nil {
93				m.detailPage.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
94			}
95			if m.wizard != nil && m.detailPage == nil {
96				m.wizard.setSize(m.width, m.contentHeight())
97			}
98			return m, nil
99	
100		case tea.KeyMsg:
101			if key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Quit) {
102				return m, tea.Quit
103			}
104	
105			if m.detailPage != nil {
106				var cmd tea.Cmd
107				*m.detailPage, cmd = m.detailPage.update(msg)
108				m.wizard = &m.detailPage.wizard
109				if cmd != nil {
110					cmds = append(cmds, cmd)
111				}
112				return m, tea.Batch(cmds...)
113			}
114	
115			if m.wizard != nil {
116				var cmd tea.Cmd
117				*m.wizard, cmd = m.wizard.update(msg)
118				if cmd != nil {
119					cmds = append(cmds, cmd)
120				}
121				return m, tea.Batch(cmds...)
122			}
123	
124			// When a sub-model is capturing input (add form, search, text input),
125			// skip global key handling so Tab/Esc/number keys reach the sub-model.
126			tabCapturesInput := (m.activeTab == tabMemories && m.memoriesTab.capturesInput()) ||
127				(m.activeTab == tabInjection && m.injectionTab.inputFocus)
128	
129			if !tabCapturesInput {
130				// Global keys -- check before delegating to tabs
131				switch {
132				case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Help):
133					m.showHelp = !m.showHelp
134					return m, nil
135				case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.TabNext):
136					m.activeTab = (m.activeTab + 1) % 4
137					return m, nil
138				case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.TabPrev):
139					m.activeTab = (m.activeTab + 3) % 4
140					return m, nil
141				case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Tab1):
142					m.activeTab = tabMemories
143					return m, nil
144				case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Tab2):
145					m.activeTab = tabInjection
146					return m, nil
147				case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Tab3):
148					m.activeTab = tabHistory
149					return m, nil
150				case key.Matches(msg, globalKeyMap.Tab4):
151					m.activeTab = tabSettings
152					return m, nil
153				}
154			}
155	
156		case stateLoadedMsg:
157			if msg.err != nil {
158				m.err = msg.err
159				return m, nil
160			}
161			m.state = msg.state
162			m.pushState()
163			return m, nil
164	
165		case addMemoryMsg:
166			return m.handleAddMemory(msg)
167	
168		case pruneMsg:
169			return m.handlePrune()
170	
171		case settingsChangedMsg:
172			return m.handleSettingsChanged(msg)
173	
174		case testPromptMsg:
175			if m.state == nil || m.state.Store == nil {
176				return m, nil
177			}
178			var selectOpts []memoryloop.SelectOption
179			if len(m.state.Store.InjectionScopes) > 0 {
180				selectOpts = append(selectOpts, memoryloop.WithInjectionScopes(m.state.Store.InjectionScopes))
181			}
182			matches := memoryloop.SelectRelevant(*m.state.Store, msg.prompt, time.Now(), selectOpts...)
183			return m, func() tea.Msg { return testPromptResultMsg{matches: matches} }
184	
185		case refreshStartedMsg:
186			if m.isRefreshing {
187				return m, nil
188			}
189			m.isRefreshing = true
190			// Full async refresh will be added in a later task.
191			return m, func() tea.Msg {
192				return flashMsg{text: "Refresh not yet implemented in TUI. Use: entire memory-loop refresh", success: false}
193			}
194	
195		case wizardOpenMsg:
196			m.showHelp = false
197			m.detailPage = m.newDetailPage(msg.record)
198			m.wizard = &m.detailPage.wizard
199			return m, nil
200	
201		case wizardCloseMsg:
202			m.detailPage = nil
203			m.wizard = nil
204			return m, nil
205	
206		case wizardResultMsg:
207			return m.handleWizardResult(msg)
208	
209		case flashMsg:
210			m.setFlash(msg.text, msg.success)
211			return m, tea.Tick(2*time.Second, func(time.Time) tea.Msg { return clearFlashMsg{} })
212	
213		case clearFlashMsg:
214			m.flashText = ""
215			m.flashStyle = lipgloss.Style{}
216			return m, nil
217		}
218	
219		// Delegate to active tab
220		var cmd tea.Cmd
221		switch m.activeTab {
222		case tabMemories:
223			m.memoriesTab, cmd = m.memoriesTab.update(msg)
224		case tabInjection:
225			m.injectionTab, cmd = m.injectionTab.update(msg)
226		case tabHistory:
227			m.historyTab, cmd = m.historyTab.update(msg)
228		case tabSettings:
229			m.settingsTab, cmd = m.settingsTab.update(msg)
230		}
231		if cmd != nil {
232			cmds = append(cmds, cmd)
233		}
234	
235		return m, tea.Batch(cmds...)
236	}
